angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 967,023 km at 180.80 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.5311 +/- 0.0170 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 180.80 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.39 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Livingston et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of EPIC 211945201 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..277L/abstract): 967,023 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.17 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Livingston et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of EPIC 211945201 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..277L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6069 +/- 90 K from Livingston et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of EPIC 211945201 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..277L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Livingston et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of EPIC 211945201 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..277L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/epic-211945201.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.220, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of EPIC 211945201 (pscomppars): spectral type G0, from Chakraborty et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156....3C/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of EPIC 211945201 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.1 dex, from Livingston et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..277L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of EPIC 211945201 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.37334, from Pope et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016MNRAS.461.3399P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of EPIC 211945201 (pscomppars): age 3.99 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of EPIC 211945201 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.1 km/s, from Howard et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
